title: Medieval War Unit Definition Schema V1.1 Current Standards Reconciliation Candidate
description: Copy-first successor candidate for noncanonical static Unit Definition records. It preserves the V1 definition contract while separating Master Unit Profile, its Stage 3 qualitative classification handoff, Faction Military Expression, Unit Specialization, later Game-Facing Unit Card, Opening State, and runtime state. Classification is transferred with source and evidence receipts and remains StaticReviewOnly. Validation does not establish Registry allocation, scenario availability, importer success, compilation, runtime behavior, save/load, migration, replay, performance, numerical balance, or battle validation. This corrected candidate preserves V1 donor coverage through direct fields or an explicit copy-first disposition ledger.

maturity_and_promotion.description: Noncanonical Unit Definition Candidate maturity only. GameFacingUnitCardReady and CanonicalImplementationReady are external later-stage contracts and are not states of this schema.

identity_relationship.description: Defines purpose separation among candidate, family, definition-candidate, and stable canonical identity.

rehomed_or_renamed.presentation: presentation_handoff with final Game-Facing Unit Card excluded
rehomed_or_renamed.Step 3 classification handoff: classification_handoff with a source-bound StaticReviewOnly classification record and transfer receipt
